welcome.title: Your daily dojo
welcome.body: Log food, water and workouts in seconds. Your coach turns it into a simple plan and one clear goal.

welcome.title: What is your goal?
welcome.body: This shapes your first steps. You can change it any time in Profile.
welcome.knownBody: Your goal is set. We will start with the steps that fit it.

welcome.title: Meet your sensei
welcome.body: Your coach guides every step. Pick who, and how they talk.
welcome.knownBody: Your coach is ready. They will guide you from here.

say.cheer: Tap + and log a glass of water. Easy first win!
say.calm: Tap + and log one glass of water.
say.strict: Tap + and log a glass of water. Now.

water.empty: Nothing logged yet. Tap + to add water.

say.cheer: Search 'dal' and add it to today. Tasty!
say.calm: Search 'dal' and add it to today.

food.empty: Nothing logged yet. Try Type a meal.

say.cheer: Add today's weight. It stays blurred until you tap it.
say.calm: Add today's weight. It stays blurred until you tap.
say.strict: Add today's weight. It stays blurred.

weight.empty: No weight yet. Add one to start your trend.

say.cheer: Log any workout, even a 10-minute walk!
say.calm: Log a workout. A short walk counts.
say.strict: Log one workout. A walk counts.

workout.empty: No workouts yet. Log a walk to begin.

say.cheer: Open the planner and plan tomorrow. Your sensei asks a few questions first.
say.calm: Open the planner and plan tomorrow. A few questions come first.
say.strict: Open the planner. Plan tomorrow. Answer the questions.

plan.empty: No plan yet. Plan tomorrow to start.

say.cheer: Tap your coach and say hi!
say.calm: Tap your coach and say hello.

coach.empty: Your coach is waiting. Tap the character.

say.cheer: This is your one goal. Progress first, finish as a date range.
say.calm: This is your one goal. It shows progress and a date range.
say.strict: One goal. Progress and a date range.

say.cheer: Progress shows your trend, weekly score and badges.
say.calm: Progress shows your trend, weekly score and badges.

reward.label: Rookie
reward.body: You finished your first week checklist. Rookie step unlocked!

line.cheer: You finished the tour. Rookie unlocked!

log.text: Everything you can log starts here. Food, water, weight and more.
No time? Use Type a meal and write it in plain words.

planner.text: Plan my week asks a few questions, then builds your plates.
Lock a meal to keep it while you shuffle the rest.
Tap Why this plate? to see the reason for any meal.

progress.text: Your trend matters more than any single day.
Weekly score and badges live under Details.

tasks.text: Small daily tasks keep you consistent. Add one with a reminder.

profile.text: Targets, reminders, coach and tour replay live here.
Your data is private. Export or delete it any time.

whatsNew.text: New: the Planning sensei asks a few questions, then builds a plan you can trust.
New: one goal, three daily quests and one badge shelf.
